motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion opacity and Y-axis slide
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle scale up (1.02), opacity changes, image zoom inside container
motion_and_interactions.custom_cursor: Small dot blending mode difference, expands on hoverables
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Staggered text reveal for hero headings (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1)

components.name: Navigation
components.rules: Fixed top, glassmorphism. Minimalist logo left, links right. Include theme toggle.

components.name: Hero Section
components.rules: Large editorial typography. Animated name reveal 'Ashish Katoch'. Role 'Frontend Web Developer'. High negative space. Small overline text.

components.name: Projects Grid
components.rules: Asymmetric bento grid. Large images with subtle hover zoom. Case study link.

components.name: Expertise & Tech Stack
components.rules: Minimal list or marquee. Use icons sparingly. Typography-driven.

components.name: Experience Timeline
components.rules: Clean vertical lines, left-aligned text. Minimalist editorial layout.

components.name: Blog / Writing Index
components.rules: List view with hover interactions. Date, Title, Tag.

components.name: Contact & Footer
components.rules: Massive CTA. Mailto form integration. Resume PDF download button.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

images.description: Minimalist dark texture for background accents if needed.
Moody developer portrait for About section.
Laptop mockup for web app case studies.
Mobile app UI for mobile case studies.

icons.instructions: Use minimal, fine-line icons where appropriate. Do not overuse.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark/light mode toggle works globally using standard Tailwind 'dark:' variant.
Use Framer Motion to create a custom cursor. Add a subtle blend mode like mix-blend-difference.
Use 'Playfair Display' for the Hero and major section headings, and 'Outfit' for all body text.
Include a 'mailto:' setup for the contact form, and add a link to download the resume.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
